title: Basic Sewing Class
description: This is the best place to start as it covers fundamentals of sewing, providing a strong foundation.

title: Intermediate Sewing Class
description: Suitable for those that have mastered Basic Sewing class course outline and are ready to be introduced to more complex techniques and projects.

title: Advanced Sewing Class
description: Designed for experienced sewists, this class focuses on mastering advanced techniques and perfecting your craft.

title: General Upgrade: Women's Wear
description: Suitable for fashion designers/tailors who wants to gain up-to-date sewing techniques and practices. It captures topics in Basic, Intermediate and Advanced Sewing classes on womenswear.

title: Ready-to-Wear Production Class
description: For students who wish to gain hands-on experience in rtw production. You will understand the complete lifecycle of garment production from concept to finished product.

title: Children's Wear Class
description: Designed to provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to design, produce and market children's clothing. Intending students should already have basic sewing skills before registering.

title: Menswear Class
description: Learn the fundamentals of designing and constructing tailored menswear, from shirts and trousers to native and formal pieces.

title: Apprenticeship Class
description: A practical, industry-focused class that offers real workshop experience and hands-on training for aspiring fashion professionals.
